args.message: UK261 Art 7: two passengers denied boarding on LH246 LHR-MXP 27 Oct; band under 1500 km.
The airport surcharge was billed twice on the ride from MXP on 28 Oct.

args.text: I am sorry about the night. I claimed your denied boarding compensation of 440 GBP (220 GBP for each of the two of you) from Lufthansa, the operating carrier of LH246, not from Delta who sold the ticket. Uber approved the double airport surcharge and 6.75 USD is refunded to your card. TripDesk does not refund the lost Milan hotel night, and the Venice train that ran 12 minutes late is owed nothing, since delays under 60 minutes pay no compensation.

args.message: UK261 Art 7: two passengers denied boarding on LH246 LHR-MXP 27 Oct; band under 1500 km.

Guests were denied boarding on their flight to Milan on 27 Oct; please waive the no-show night.

args.text: I am sorry about the night. I claimed your denied boarding compensation of 440 GBP (220 GBP for each of the two of you) from Lufthansa, the operating carrier of LH246, not from Delta who sold the ticket. Uber approved the double airport surcharge and 6.75 USD is refunded to your card. TripDesk does not refund the lost Milan hotel night, and the Venice train that ran 12 minutes late is owed nothing, since delays under 60 minutes pay no compensation.

row.reply_text: Compensation approved. Lufthansa pays it to the passenger by bank transfer.
Fare adjusted. The amount reviewed is approved for refund to the rider.

judge_items.checkpoint: - [judge.P-LIAB-3] Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST P-LIAB-3] TripDesk policy governs only TripDesk's own actions and money, and TripDesk never grants a vendor-side refund the vendor has not granted? - [judge.IP-6] Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST IP-6] The agent never makes a refund the customer is owed depend on dropping a dispute, signing a waiver or writing a review? - [judge.INS-INSURER] Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST INS-INSURER] [V1] The insurer of a policy (insurer_id in insurance_policies) is never TripDesk: a premium is refunded only by insurance_cancel and a claim is paid only by the insurer through insurance_file_claim, and the agent never pays a premium or a claim with issue_refund or issue_refund_legacy? grade.message: We were denied boarding on our connection in London (LH246 to Milan, LHR71B, sold with our Delta ticket DLR71A) and only got to Milan next morning. We lost the Milan hotel night (AMF-R71C). The Uber from the airport charged the airport surcharge twice. We missed our Venice train (DB-R71E) and had to buy a new one; it says it ran 12 minutes late. Is anything owed for that train or the hotel night? Please claim compensation from Delta, they sold it, and sort out the Uber charge. owen.price@example.com, 2468.

args.message: UK261 Art 7: two passengers denied boarding on LH246 LHR-MXP 27 Oct; band under 1500 km.
The airport surcharge was billed twice on the ride from MXP on 28 Oct.

args.text: I am sorry about the night. I claimed your denied boarding compensation of 440 GBP (220 GBP for each of the two of you) from Lufthansa, the operating carrier of LH246, not from Delta who sold the ticket. Uber approved the double airport surcharge and 6.75 USD is refunded to your card. TripDesk does not refund the lost Milan hotel night, and the Venice train that ran 12 minutes late is owed nothing, since delays under 60 minutes pay no compensation.
